name: How much does it cost to paint and finish a home addition in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to paint and finish a home addition in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of painting and finishing a home addition in the East Bay area varies significantly based on factors like the size of the addition, the quality of materials selected, and the complexity of the job. Generally, costs can range from $2,000 to $10,000 or more. This estimate typically includes labor, paint, and finishing materials. It's recommended to get a detailed quote from a local contractor after an on-site assessment to understand the specific costs for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs range from $2,000 to $10,000+, depending on size, materials, and complexity. A detailed quote from a local contractor is recommended.
